inputs.name: CMD.KEY

DBREAD 0
HAM5.DB
PROBID

expect.notes: DB search: HAM5.DB stem starts with PROBID 'HAM' and differs -> suffix '5' (5 >= |step|) -> problem name becomes HAM5, db = <cwd>\HAM5.DB; AMG_DXT.INI line 1 'HAM5', GEO read from HAM5.GEO. Only one match, so the suspicious qsort comparator is not called.
